experiment: combine mutability and loop-control body walks
hypothesis: Checking mutability and invalid break/continue placement in one traversal should reduce front-end CPU and possibly wall time without changing diagnostics.
measurement: Quill check-subset front-end only; not a Cargo build or Rust compile-time result.
measurement_method: Five fresh processes; Linux wait4 rusage for process CPU and peak RSS; perf_counter wall time.
decision: Reject the change: it did not demonstrate a speed or memory improvement; the medians slightly regressed and run ranges overlap. Restore the separate passes.
correctness_gate: The combined version passed typeck and workspace tests; restored version retains the same tested separate-pass implementation.
